note: Which registered detectors gate each evidence lane, and at which level (warn or fail). A lane may list only detectors of the classes or stages its laneGatingSets entry in the qualification policy names. scripts/audio_qc_lane_gates.py validate refuses a listed detector without a committed calibration record that qualified it at that level or a stricter one, for its current definition (A7), at an operating point that applies to the lane's kind, and whose scope covers the lane (A1): every lane language in the record's scope with a measured per-language FAR, the lane's modes when the record or its detector names modes (a detector confirmed on N2, a codec round trip of human speech, is mode-independent), and the lane's FAR population as the record's confirmation population. No lane gates on a detector until its record is committed; the lists start empty.
